Bug_Title: Overrides should match their parent class methods in synchronization
Bug_Explanation: The `foo()` method in the `Child` class overrides the `foo()` method in the `Parent` class, but it is not itself synchronized. This can lead to improper synchronization as callers rely on the thread-safety promised by the parent class.
